scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: composer --working-dir=backend install --no-interaction --no-progress && npm --prefix backend ci && npm run backend:prepare
scripts.backend:prepare: npm run backend:env && npm run backend:migrate && npm run eoa:install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run validate:entrepreneurs && npm run build
